notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[h1]🏖️ Summer Update Now Live![/h1]
Grab your shades and blast off — the Combine 2 Pumpkins Summer Update is here!
This chilled-out content drop brings:

[h3]🌴 Two Brand-New Maps[/h3]
[b]Sunny Beach[/b] – A tropical getaway filled with sand, palm trees, and lots of sun.

[b]Planet Gourd[/b] – A sci-fi adventure set on an alien world filled with interstellar atmosphere. 

[h3]🧙‍♀️ Past Seasonal Maps Return![/h3]
For the first time ever, [b]all past seasonal levels are unlocked and playable[/b] — from spooky nights to snowy peaks and everything in between. Play your favorite map or switch it up and play a random map every time!

[h3]🎥 Trailer[/h3]
Check out the trailer and catch the summer vibe:
[previewyoutube=2J4ZCtk3m_0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Available today — no time limits, just sunshine and squashes.[/b]

See you on the beach (or the spaceship)!🧃

notes.title: 🏰 Hear ye, hear ye! Pumpkins in the Middle Ages?!
notes.content:
Noble pumpkin combiners, a grand [b]Medieval Level [/b] has been unveiled in Combine 2 Pumpkins! 

Step into a bustling medieval town, nestled in the shadow of a mighty castle, and immerse thyself in the grand atmosphere of the Middle Ages! 
But beware! Even in these chivalrous times, the pumpkin trade remains as puzzling as ever!

⚔️ Available now until the end of March!

Sharpen thy wits, embrace the challenge, and may fortune favor thee! HUZZAH! 🏰

notes.title: Pumpkins World Tour starts now in Japan!
notes.content:
🌸✨ [b]New Seasonal Level – Tokyo Dancing Club + 50% Off![/b] ✨🌸

[b]ダンスフロアでカボチャと踊ろう！[/b] 🕺 

Get ready to groove with the pumpkins in a brand-new, seasonal level of Combine 2 Pumpkins! 🎉
Welcome to the Tokyo Dancing Club – a vibrant, high-energy stage ruled by the disco rhythm!

🕺[b] What’s new?[/b]

+ New Tokyo-inspired theme 🗼
+ Disco beats and lighting to set the mood 🎶
+ A special surprise for high scorers 🎁

[b]💸 50% Off for One Week Only![/b]

To celebrate this event, Combine 2 Pumpkins is 50% off on Steam for the first week – starting tomorrow! Don’t miss your chance to join the fun and share the game with your friends.

🎯 Seasonal Availability

The [b]Tokyo Dancing Club[/b] level will only be available from today until the end of February. Don’t miss out!

🌟 Update your game to experience the [b]Tokyo Dancing Club[/b]! Be sure to share your high scores, combos, and feedback with the community – we can’t wait to hear from you!

Happy combining, and let’s hit the dance floor! 🎃💃

notes.title: Winter Season Begins Now!
notes.content:
❄️ Winter Season Event Begins Now! ❄️

Bundle up and get ready for a frosty adventure – the Winter Season has officially started in Combine 2 Pumpkins! ⛄

🌨️ New Winter Mountain Map
Starting today, you can enjoy the brand-new Winter Mountain Map, a beautiful but chilly landscape with lots to discover. This map will be available until the end of the year, so don’t miss your chance to experience the seasonal fun!

💸 -50% Discount This Weekend!
From Friday morning to Monday morning, you can grab Combine 2 Pumpkins for half the price on Steam! It’s the perfect time to jump in or gift the game to a fellow puzzle lover.

🏆 High Score Challenge at GDS
Visiting GDS this weekend? Swing by my booth to play the game in person, chat about its development and compete for a pumpkin-themed prize in the High Score Challenge.

❄️ Join the Fun
Share your winter-themed combos and high scores – we’d love to see what you can achieve!

Happy Winter and happy combining! 🌟

notes.title: Mr Spook's favorite time of year is here!
notes.content:
🎃 Spooky surprise! Halloween Map is now available! 🎃

Get ready to dive into the Halloween spirit on a brand-new themed map! 👻 
Starting today, you can explore our spooky-themed level packed with eerie vibes and evil pumpkin spice! 

This special Halloween map is only available for a limited time this week, so jump in and check it out while you can! And, of course, don’t forget to share your high scores and Halloween combos – we can’t wait to see what you all achieve! 🍂✨

Happy Halloween and happy combining! 🎉
